elements.label: Brush underline under 'new'

pattern.description: Two-line title card appears from blank, settling from a slightly larger scale to rest; a hand-drawn brush underline then draws on beneath the italic word 'new'.
pattern.why_premium: Fast, confident scale settle keeps the title crisp, and the single hand-drawn accent on the italic keyword adds human warmth and directs the eye to the key word without extra chrome.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.title-line', {opacity:0, scale:1.15}, {opacity:1, scale:1, duration:0.25, ease:'power3.out'}); then tl.fromTo('.underline path', {strokeDashoffset:len}, {strokeDashoffset:0, duration:0.3, ease:'power2.out'}, '+=0.25').
build_hint.remotion: Title: scale = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config:{damping:200, stiffness:200, mass:1}}), [0,1], [1.15,1]) with opacity 0->1 over 6 frames; underline: SVG strokeDashoffset interpolated over ~9 frames, starting ~8 frames after the title settles, Easing.out(Easing.cubic).

notes: Thumbnails are centre-cropped, so the entry reads as a scale-down from larger; could partly be a slide_up. Underline lands at the very end of the burst (f78) and may belong to the following event.
